details: **What is happening:** Gen Z and Millennials are actively rejecting traditional hustle culture, prioritizing mental health, work-life balance, and a 'quiet life' over constant busyness and achievement. details: **What is happening:** The 4-day work week has moved from an experimental idea to a proven model, with studies showing maintained or improved productivity and significant gains in employee well-being. AI productivity gains are seen as a natural enabler for shorter workweeks.

topics.name: Digital Nomadism & Location-Independent Living
details: **What is happening:** The digital nomad lifestyle continues to grow, driven by remote work opportunities, affordable technology, and a desire for freedom. More countries are offering digital nomad visas, and the trend is evolving to include a focus on community and intentional living.
